findings_resolved.finding: Parsed terminal identity was initially copied after telemetry, so telemetry failure could erase known response identity.
findings_resolved.resolution: Current candidate copies terminal status, response identity and metadata, then binds stream event, before provider-wait-exit telemetry.

findings_resolved.finding: Diagnostic projection and budget/result finalization initially shared one try, allowing projection failure to skip actual finalization.
findings_resolved.resolution: Best-effort failure projection is now separate; every budget.finish/result persistence attempt still runs and primary exception remains retained.

limitations: SOURCE acceptance is only for the separate finite synthetic/inert boundary series, with exact imports and I/O independently reviewed before grant.
No end-to-end owner admission is granted. Current active UNKNOWN and consumed owner reservation remain unchanged.
The actual lost inner exception is not asserted reproduced by injected controls.
Private/stdlib frame paths are excluded; their safe class may be retained, but arbitrary exception classes are sanitized.
properties: Captured finite source identity pins precede reservation; failure handler does not scan or reread source/admission files.
Request authentication, current role validation, body, source gates, and dispatch boundary remain in place. Substage assignments add no provider call or request retry.

Exact SOURCE-relative Python frame paths/hashes, line and closed function names are bounded to128 visited and32 retained frames; no locals, arbitrary error text, raw HTTP headers or credentials are exported.
Original exception classes/codes are projected through finite safe registries. Unknown values remain sanitized; the missing original074128 exception cannot be reconstructed.

Preterminal generic exception retains UNKNOWN and active-UNKNOWN semantics. Parsed terminal followed by a local exception is labeled POSTTERMINAL_LOCAL/FAILED and is not reported as uncertain transport.
BaseException cleanup failures cannot replace an earlier primary; HTTP close, watchdog finish and both durable finalizers are attempted. Failure of finalizers is retained as secondary when possible.
The projector enforces finite schema, substage/category/type/code registries, path/line/hash/function bounds and optional exact source_pins; displayed diagnostic remains evidence, never authority.
required_offline_controls: Preterminal request/response-boundary failure: no terminal/product, UNKNOWN remains.
Postterminal local product refusal: terminal and response identity preserved, FAILED, original bounded class/code/frames visible.
Valid Critic product reaches accepted transport emission without changed semantics.
Original primary remains primary through cleanup, telemetry or diagnostic-projection failure; budget/result finalization attempts remain observable.
review_scope: Exact transport and safe diagnostic projector delta, imports, error paths, callback/finalization ordering and bounded I/O. Existing unrelated source campaigns are reused, not repeated.
